answer: Because each pulse escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the bridge ledger records every share and the gale audit exposes the split. Assembling that for 112 aliases means 112 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
